verdict.rationale: LM Studio documents Bionic, its own agent that creates and edits documents and handles "advanced agentic tasks" with local models. A hands-on user said it "works great," but noted usability gaps, and community describes Bionic as a separate new app rather than a feature inside the main LM Studio app. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of which tasks can be delegated and how, clear evidence that the assistant is built into the core app rather than shipped as a companion app, and resolved hands-on caveats (unclear working directory, no model preload or unload).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Work with Bionic to create and edit documents. Every change is automatically saved, so you can work with your agent freely.
use them for simple chats or advanced agentic tasks
I gave Bionic a shot immediately. First impression: it works great
